theorems.name: Submission.dorag_haa_ball_rescale_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (IntegrableOn (fun y => F (r • y)) (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1) ↔ IntegrableOn F (ball (0 : Euclid n) r)) ∧ ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, F (r • y) = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, F x
